rationale: Single CMU newsroom item on Resolution 712 security profiles — key evidence; the kmu.gov.ua newsroom itself is the monitorable parent.
Commercial LigaZakon copy of CMU 518; legal status unclear and zakon.rada is the authoritative equivalent.
Ombudsman DPA section publishes ongoing clarifications and inspection results — durable enforcement-signal source.
Rada bill card is a live status tracker with dates for the GDPR-alignment data protection law.
Standalone UA cyber trade outlet section that reliably summarises new SSSCIP/CMU acts and deadlines.
One-off Deloitte alert on non-bank FI cybersecurity requirements; useful evidence, the alerts hub would be the source.
NABU circulates NBU draft resolutions during consultation; valuable but URL check failed — re-verify liveness.
UAPS news feed covers the PSP half of the cell; verification failed, needs a liveness recheck.
NCCC/NSDC activity section carries cyber strategy implementation tasking that becomes binding rules.
SSSCIP qualification-centre subsite; niche competence standards, largely covered by monitoring SSSCIP.
Single EU4Digital programme article on CI cybersecurity alignment; good background evidence, not a recurring feed.
One-off EN law-firm alert on Law 4336-IX; handy briefing artefact rather than a monitored source.
NBU KIS is the authoritative live lookup for non-bank PSPs and financial institutions — core actor-enumeration surface.
Machine-readable DRFU dataset refreshed twice monthly — ideal change-detection feed for regulated non-banks.
CKAN API is the cheapest programmatic route to all UA open registers; bare endpoint 404s without params, not a real failure.
NBU statdirectory API gives machine-readable directories and reporting-entity code lists.
Canonical NBU bank & branch directory API — backbone MFO/EDRPOU identifier table for the actor map.
NBU non-bank licensing hub explains PSP authorisation procedure and links decision lists and registers.
NBU news feed of payment-licence grants names licensees ahead of register refresh — high-frequency tripwire.
DGF register of insolvent/liquidated banks keeps the actor map free of dead institutions.
Official NSDC sanctions register is in scope for actor filtering; URL verification failed, recheck reachability.
OpenSanctions mirror gives normalised bulk data avoiding scraping of the official register.
EDR open dataset supplies EDRPOU join keys for every bank, PSP and processor.
Tag facet on data.gov.ua is a discovery view to mine for financial-sector datasets, then archive.
Directory of UA open-data portals — mine once for mirror/secondary publication points.
Regulatory function catalogue maps NBU register-keeping permits; useful one-off mining but URL check failed.
Legal text defining payment-infrastructure register fields and deadlines; go-link failed, resolve to stable zakon.rada URL.
NSSMC register page delimits capital-markets entities from the NBU-supervised population.
